label: woman · 30s · warm Indian English
description: An Indian woman in her thirties speaking fluent English with a natural Indian accent. Warm, clear and articulate, friendly and engaging nonfiction narrator.
ref_text: The old house at the end of the lane had stood empty for many years. Each autumn, the leaves gathered on its steps, and the village children wondered who had lived there, and why they had never come back.
